core_result: Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 suite (25 files, 23,289 lines, 37 audited declarations + 2,306 TriadFrontier.* axiom-swept declarations under module, six kernels in CI run 46066941475) of formalized PIR/MLWE/complexity results alongside exact multi-precision computational verifiers. Kernel-checked: Koszul-Veronese moment annihilation, Pascal binomial identity, and (6,3,3) arithmetic (T1a); symmetric coded/Byzantine PIR rate inequalities (T1b-T1d); scale-128 polymatroid and 6-subspace F_2^64 retrieval realization at 8/13 > 3/5 (T1e-T1j) backed by T1k proving standard vector-space HasSpanDim & Steinitz soundness for matRankModP (F_2, F_3) and gf2RankSparse (closing ERRATA L02) plus field-universal 2-file N-server K-MDS flag-private PIR exact zero-error decoding and two-sided colluder-transcript bijection Psi_I; T1l (v5.4.0) certifying unconditional in-kernel constructive existence over SimpleField (Fin 101) of the explicit (6,3,3) rate-10/17 > 4/7 zero-error PIR scheme (DecInv*M_des=I_60, Cancel*M_pure=M_mixed, all 20/20 GL_20 flag isomorphisms, closing S01/A02 inside all 6 kernels, also cross-verified in Python & ISO C11 90/90 unit + live encode/decode); ring-universal anti-periodic & m-twisted DFT cancellation, diagonal q^m determinant, and pure-Nat moment/Renyi-2 DPI/tensorization/R_infty inequalities for CBD_eta & 8/9/10/14-bit branchless dyadic samplers (T2a-T2i); exact NIST FIPS 203 Eq. (4.7) Compress_1 margins (T3d, L01 fixed); characteristic-free rank_F(<2,2,2>)=7 (T3h), substitution bound 2m^2-m (T3i), Schwartz-Zippel & Strassen bounds (T3k), Haemers & Lovasz Theta(C_5)=sqrt(5) (T3j), conditional Z[sqrt(4k+1)] conference-graph capacity instantiated for P_5, P_13, P_17 (T3l), and T3m (v5.4.0, superseding A10) proving Markus Blaser's (FOCS 1999) 5/2 m^2 - 3m matrix-multiplication lower bound (5*m^2 - 6*m <= 2*rank_F(<m,m,m>)) over every SimpleField F including F_2 (strictly beating Brockett-Dobkin's 2m^2-1 for all m >= 6, e.g. m=6 => r >= 72 > 71) and tightening the power-of-2 sandwich to 5*4^k - 6*2^k <= 2*rank_F(<2^k,2^k,2^k>) <= 2*7^k.
